title: Rockie Tastic
description: This is a PVP texture pack that adds things I prefer for PVP.
body:
This PvP pack makes swords shorter, axes smaller, wool outlined, and more! For the most part, this texture pack is pretty small, but works for Bedwars on a modern version and also normal modern PvP.

![Iron sword that is short but with a dot at the end, good for both modern and old PvP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3926c22fa8923231373a18d4d9032da24d91497b.png)![Diamond sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fced1b5d62aded89e9aa15c7ddfe2fd5df9a771.png)![Copper sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63550f9e56bbe9d8498189807fd998286de3b665.png)![Baseball bat that replaces the wood sword for comedic effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05219194c985a4df7a888c9b61007c26822e47f5.png)![Gold sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e92565cac0672b220a3f83bd95ffc3782787e8f3.png)![Netherite sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/75e7961524d86c9527c3bc0e4d2b6e3acb6a9f28.png)

If you put it into minecraft, it will say "made for an older version" even though that isn't true. I tried to fix it, but I couldn't find anything that said what version it is made for. Just ignore it if you can.
